items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Oh, I know Buddy Bolden. I know his sister, his mother, and all of them.

ctx.x: Did he ever mention another trumpet player, Buddy Bolden, or did you ever hear him?
Oh no, he didn't play with Buddy. Buddy was out of the class. Buddy played, but he didn't play with Buddy.
Do you remember hearing Buddy Bolden yourself?
